resources.string: Choose public read-only access or verify the repository owner with GitHub.
No login required. You can inspect Compatibility Farm status and public evidence, but privileged controls remain unavailable.
GitHub Device Flow verifies the exact owner, GitHub App installation, repository permission, and then the short-lived backend authorization proof.
Normally discovered automatically. This field is only a recovery override and is not a secret.
GitHub code copied to the clipboard.
Complete authorization in GitHub. Source Lab will continue automatically when GitHub confirms it.
GitHub identity verified. Connecting backend authorization…
Owner session is valid and short-lived. Sensitive actions still require their own explicit capability gate.
The GitHub user token is kept in memory only. No client secret, private key, or write token is embedded in the APK.
Owner identity and backend authorization do not automatically unlock Run Farm, Approve, Promote, Sign, or Publish. Each action stays fail-closed until its dedicated capability wiring is complete.
